s.p.papier.sub: E tangohia ana he whakaahua o tētahi tuhipoka, he rongoā, he tātai, he tohu rānei: e whakaakona ana i roto i tō rātou reo.
s.p.papier.private: Ka noho tonu te whakaahua i runga i tōmu whatunga. Ko te kupu anake i akohia ka tukuna ki te ratonga whakamāoritanga wātea.
s.p.papier.first: I te wā tuatahi mō tēnei reo: ka whakahuatia e te rorohiko ōna raraunga ako (he tokomaha ngā MB).
s.p.papier.reading: E ako ana i te tuhinga… {p} %
s.p.papier.read_t: Ka uiuitia te kupu (whakarerekē i a ia mēnā e hiahiatia ana)
s.p.papier.none: Kāore he kupu i kitea. Ka tangohia anō te whakaahua, mārama ake hoki me te mārama ake.
s.p.papier.e_lib: Kāore i taea te tīmata te whakaako: e hiahiatia ana e te wā tuatahi te Ipurangi. Whakamātau anō ina honohia.
s.p.papier.e_read: Kāore i angitu te akoranga. Whakau anō i te whakaahua.
s.p.papier.translate: Ka whakamāoritia ki roto i tōku reo
s.p.papier.e_tr: Kāore i taea te whakamāoritanga (whakapānga, te tepe rānei o te rā). Whakanao anō.
s.p.papier.warn: Ka whakamāoritia e te mīhini: mō tētahi tuhinga hira (kāwanatanga, hauora, moni, whakaaetanga noho), ka tirohia e tētahi tangata e whakapono ana ki a koe, he pāhono rānei.
s.p.papier.help: E pā ana ki te āwhina i roto i te āwhina ā-whāiti
